text:
Rena: Quick sprint 1pm  we need a compact launch battlecard for the webinar: audience is infra buyers + platform PMs. Focus: three rebut lines, one memorable metaphor, and exact inbound routing tags.
Cole: For rebut lines I suggest: 1) "Predictable serving beats peak benchmarks" 2) "Unit cost matters more than catalog breadth" 3) "Deployment parity reduces go-live risk". Keep each to one short sentence.
Aria: Can we attach a single metric per line? Ops has 30d snapshots, but let's avoid % claims. Use medians/p99.
Ben: Ops snippet: dedicated pools 30d p99 ~= 128ms at seq=512; sustained throughput at seq=1024 = 20 tps. I'll let ops-bot paste the snapshot id.
ops-bot: Snapshot created: ms-2026-186543 p99=128ms (seq=512, dedicated), tps=20 (seq=1024). Link: https://perf.redwood/snap/ms-2026-186543.
Rena: Nice. Metaphor idea: "Think of models as engines; Redwood is the runway and air traffic control." Short and imagery-forward. Different from the airline line but similar tone.
Cole: Love it. For messaging tone: client-facing, no infra jargon in visible bullets. Put a short tech footnote for "batching/response caching".
Aria: Inbound routing: propose three tags on the form: `lead_tier:enterprise|mid|selfserve`, `needs_capacity:true|false`, `compliance:high|low`. Map enterprise+needs_capacity -> AE + SolutionsEng; compliance:high -> Privacy + Security SME cc. forms-bot can implement.
forms-bot: Proposed fields created: `lead_tier`, `needs_capacity`, `compliance_level`. PR: https://git.redwood/forms/pull/981.
Ben: Add a micro-ops callout for graceful degradation: "automatic fallback to lower-precision variant + cross-region failover to maintain latency SLAs". Keep it one line on the battlecard.
Cole: For the one-pager layout: header (1 sentence), 3 bullets (each 1 line + metric footnote), sticky metaphor box, inbound routing table (3 rows), two footnotes (perf snapshot, cost explainer).
Rena: I'll draft the first-pass. Volunteers to review tech accuracy? Ben and Aria please. Also need a short inbound CTA mapping for the webinar slide: "Request a predictable pilot" for enterprise-capacity leads.
Aria: I'll validate the footnote links and check anonymized case snippets.
Ben: I'll check the ops wording and confirm we can safely surface the p99 number.
Rena: Timeline: draft by 3pm, review 4pm, finalize for slides by 6pm. Link will be posted to repo: https://git.redwood/marketing/launch/precision-battlecard-draft.md
Cole: Quick copy note: swap internal terms like "KV cache" for "response caching" in visible copy. Technical details remain in footnotes.
Rena: Perfect. Thanks team. We'll iterate in the PR. :rocket:
